name: Legal research on EU and UK legislation
about: Issues stated as a tribunal or a pleading states them, each with the provisions a lawyer would cite (2: the provision that governs it; 1: one also in point). Searched over the whole corpus of the issue's legal system, so every other provision of every other instrument is a distractor. Written for ELI Legal's evaluation; the provisions are real, the issues are not drawn from any real matter.
unit: A provision: a section, a Schedule paragraph, an article (any of its paragraphs) or a recital.
